name: Iron Gauntlet
description: A weathered iron gauntlet, once belonging to a nameless warrior.

name: Worn Wooden Shield
description: A wooden shield scarred with countless blade marks, yet still sturdy.

name: Charm of Life
description: A heart-shaped charm, strangely warm when held close.

name: Small Mana Gem
description: A small gem giving off a soft glow, its inner current of energy never fading.

name: Sharp Claw
description: A monster's claw honed into a secondary weapon.

name: Stone of Endurance
description: A heavy stone etched with ancient runes, giving off a strange sense of steadiness.

name: Ring of Focus
description: A silver ring that calms the mind, making it easier to reach for magic.

name: Warrior's Necklace
description: A necklace forged from monster fangs, a symbol of a battle once won.

name: Pendant of Calm
description: A pendant engraved with a crescent moon, radiating calm amid the dark.

name: Traveler's Ration
description: A small pouch of dried rations always kept close, its very presence steadying the mind for the road ahead.

name: Ancient Sword
description: An ancient sword with a faded engraving no one has managed to read.

name: Heart of Stone
description: A heart-shaped piece of stone, ice-cold yet it makes its bearer unyielding.

name: Eternal Vial
description: A glass vial holding a liquid that never runs dry, a current of life swirling within.

name: Arcane Core
description: A crystallized core of arcane energy, humming as if whispering incantations.

name: Thorned Armor
description: Armor bristling with outward-facing thorns, rusted brown at the tips.

name: Venomous Dagger (Relic)
description: An ancient dagger whose venom has soaked deep into every layer of steel, never fading.

name: Vampiric Fang
description: A razor-sharp fang that drains a bit of life force with every bite that lands.

name: Featherweight Boots
description: A pair of boots as light as a feather, footsteps barely touching the ground.

name: Quickcharge Rune
description: A hastily carved rune that shortens the lull between two skill casts.

name: Spiked Cloak
description: A cloak studded with iron spikes, heavy enough to drag on the ground.

name: Serpent Ring
description: A ring carved into a coiled serpent, its hidden fangs still dripping venom.

name: Thunder Totem
description: A totem carved with a lightning bolt, occasionally discharging a jolt of electricity on its own.

name: Armor of Wholeness
description: A suit of armor without a single crack, as if it had never tasted battle.

name: Bloodthirsty Blade
description: A blood-thirsty blade that seems to grow stronger with every strike.

name: Phantom Step
description: A pair of mist-shrouded boots, each step leaving a faint afterimage to throw off incoming attacks.

name: Scholar's Insight
description: A dungeon scholar's notebook, meticulously recording the fastest ways to learn from every battle.

name: Crown of Destruction
description: The cracked crown of a fallen tyrant, still echoing with a hunger for destruction.

name: Immortal Heart
description: A heart, severed from its body long ago, that still beats in your hand.

name: Reaper's Covenant
description: A pact with death itself — every life claimed returns a share of vitality to its bearer.

name: Eternal Scholar's Tome
description: An ancient tome that never grows old, every page teaching a wiser way to fight.

name: Blackened Locket
description: A locket shrouded in black smoke. Open it and there's nothing inside but cold.

name: Shackle of Hunger
description: A rusted shackle that gnaws at its wearer's guard, in exchange for a rage that's hard to contain.

name: Unstable Core
description: An unstable core of energy, shaking violently and drawing every hostile gaze toward its bearer.

name: Heavy Guilt
description: An invisible weight pressing down on the shoulders, making defensive moves slower and more careless.
